name: CIB seven AI Agent (ad hoc sub process)
description: An AI agent runs this ad hoc sub process: it decides which of its activities to start, and each activity is a tool. A tool gets a value from the model through ${toolParameter(toolCall.<name>, '<description>', '<type>')} in one of its input mappings; the type is string, integer, number or boolean, with a trailing ? when the model may leave the value out.

properties.label: Max model calls per turn
properties.description: Model calls allowed in one turn, and tool calls in one answer of the model. Default 25.

pattern.message: A positive whole number, or empty for the default.

properties.label: Max turns
properties.description: Turns allowed before the agent stops. A turn starts on entry and whenever an activity ends. Default 10. Activities already running still finish.

pattern.message: A positive whole number, or empty for the default.

properties.label: Max turns total
properties.description: Turns allowed across all entries together. Only with 'Continue across entries'; empty means no total limit.

pattern.message: A positive whole number, or empty for no total cap.

properties.label: On limit
properties.description: 'Continue' (default): when a limit is reached and nothing the agent started still runs, the scope ends and the outcome names the limit. 'Throw a BPMN error': at that moment the scope throws a BPMN error with that code instead; a boundary error event on this scope must catch it. Max model calls per turn ends only the turn: while an activity still runs, the agent is asked again when it ends.

properties.label: Conversation
properties.description: 'Start new on each entry' (default): every entry starts with an empty conversation. 'Continue across entries': the agent remembers earlier entries, e.g. in a feedback loop, within the window of Chat memory max messages. It is not available on a parallel multi-instance scope, and while such a conversation is kept the process instance cannot be migrated: until the scope around this sub process ends, or until the instance ends when the sub process sits directly in the process.

properties.label: Message
properties.description: The agent's task, e.g. 'Handle order ${orderNumber}.' Evaluated again for every model call, so it shows the current process data.

properties.label: Instruction
properties.description: System prompt for the LLM. Leave empty to use the bundled default prompt (generic CIB seven agent that uses any wired-in tools, RAG and chat memory). Override to specialise the agent for a concrete task. See 'Instruction mode' to control whether this value replaces or augments the bundled default.

properties.label: Instruction mode
properties.description: 'Append' (preset): your instruction after the built-in prompt; 'Prepend': before it; 'Replace': only yours. Ignored when Instruction is empty.

properties.label: Follow-up on re-entry
properties.description: Only with 'Continue across entries': sent instead of Message in the first turn after the scope is entered again, e.g. 'The user said: ${feedback}.' If it fails or is empty, Message is used.

properties.label: Base URL
properties.description: API base URL. Examples: https://api.openai.com/v1 (OpenAI, default), https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (OpenRouter), http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama), etc.

properties.label: Model
properties.description: LLM model identifier, e.g. gpt-5.5, claude-opus-4.7, gemma-4-26b. On OpenRouter prefix with provider: openai/gpt-5.5.

properties.label: API key
properties.description: API key for the LLM provider. Use an expression to reference a process variable, e.g. ${apiKey}.

properties.label: HTTP headers
properties.description: Additional request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer sk-..."}.

properties.label: Reasoning effort
properties.description: For o-series models: low, medium, or high.

properties.label: Reasoning summary
properties.description: For o-series models: auto, concise, or detailed.

properties.label: Chat memory max messages
properties.description: Default 20, about the last six calls; earlier tool results and answers are dropped, and a larger window sends more with every call. With 'Continue across entries' an empty value means at least 53, and a value below 2 * the effective Max model calls per turn + 3 is rejected.

properties.label: Persist chat-log audit variable
properties.description: Override the chat-log variable for this activity. 'No' skips the DB write (pair with an external audit sink for EU AI Act Art. 12 / 26(6) compliance).

pattern.message: Must be a numeric port number

properties.label: Max RAG results
properties.description: Maximum number of documents to retrieve from the vector store.

properties.label: Min RAG score
properties.description: Minimum similarity score (0.0–1.0) for RAG results to be included. Default: 0.0 (no filtering).

properties.label: Embedding dimension
properties.description: Dimension of the embedding vectors. Default: 384 (AllMiniLmL6V2), 1536 for text-embedding-ada-002.

properties.label: Embedding model name
properties.description: Name of the embedding model used to encode documents and queries. Default: AllMiniLmL6V2 (local, 384-dim). Use text-embedding-ada-002 for OpenAI.

properties.label: Output variable for agent response
properties.description: Process variable that will receive the agent's text response (${output}). Applied after every turn, so it holds the last turn's answer.

properties.label: Output variable for AI-output marker (EU AI Act Art. 50(2))
properties.description: Process variable for the marker of AI-generated output (${outputAiMeta}): aiGenerated, runId, provider, model, responseId, generatedAt. After a limit it holds only aiGenerated=false and generatedAt. Leave the field unset to skip this output.

properties.label: Output variable for the turn's outcome
properties.description: How the agent's last turn ended, for a gateway after the scope: completed (it called completeScope), ended (it answered and nothing runs), turnLimit, totalTurnLimit or callLimit. While the scope runs it may read waiting. Leave the field unset to skip this output.
